description: Boundary and logical-path coverage for extracting forwarded ports from firewall NAT rule dumps: empty dumps, dumps containing only non-forwarding bookkeeping, forwarding rules with and without a pinned destination address, the maximum port value, and multiple forwarding rules in one dump.

input.rules:
-P PREROUTING ACCEPT
-N CNI-HOSTPORT-DNAT
-A POSTROUTING -m comment --comment "CNI portfwd requiring masquerade" -j CNI-HOSTPORT-MASQ
-A CNI-HOSTPORT-MASQ -m mark --mark 0x2000/0x2000 -j MASQUERADE

-A CNI-DN-dddddddddddddddddddddd -p tcp -m tcp --dport 7000 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.4.0.30:80
-A CNI-DN-eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee -d 127.0.0.1/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 7001 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.4.0.31:80

cases.expected_output:
tcp=true ip=0.0.0.0 port=7000
tcp=true ip=127.0.0.1 port=7001
